nodes.name: AI Agents: Autonomous Reasoning and Tool Use
nodes.summary: Lesson on LLM-based agents: the observe-reason-act control loop, tool use, and the lineage from symbolic GOFAI systems (GPS, STRIPS, SHRDLU, Soar, BDI) to ReAct.

nodes.name: Context Windows & Memory: What LLMs Can Hold in Mind
nodes.summary: Lesson on context windows: the fixed-size token buffer, size growth from 1K to 1M+ tokens, token/word conversion, the self-attention O(n^2) bottleneck, and the 'lost in the middle' attention effect.

nodes.name: contextwindows.js
nodes.summary: Auto-injects scoped CSS and renders the context-window segment bar diagram and the U-shaped 'lost in the middle' attention bar chart; exposes window.loadContextwindowsModule.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE that injects a scoped <style> tag at runtime and exposes its loader on window.

nodes.name: Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.summary: Lesson on LLM evaluation: the four benchmark families (multiple-choice, exact-match, LLM-judge, human preference), the math of MMLU/HellaSwag/ARC/GSM8K/HumanEval, and benchmark contamination and Goodhart's law.

nodes.name: Fine-Tuning & Post-Training
nodes.summary: Lesson on the post-training pipeline SFT -> DPO/KTO/GRPO -> RLHF (PPO) -> reasoning RL, with the cross-entropy SFT loss, reward modeling, and preference-optimization objectives.

nodes.name: finetuninglab.js
nodes.summary: Post-training demo: a scenario picker rendering raw 'base' data vs 'fine-tuned assistant output' (Wikipedia HTML, C++ sort, 0.999=1 forum) with Prism/Mermaid/Markdown re-rendering and IntersectionObserver-based lazy init.
nodes.languageNotes: Global TrainingLab object plus an IntersectionObserver-based lazy-init registry.

nodes.name: Hallucinations and Dangers of AI and How to use AI Safely
nodes.summary: Lesson on hallucinations: LLMs as pattern-completion engines, next-token probability, the role of temperature/softmax, the dangers of blind trust, and safe-use guidance.

nodes.name: hallucinations.js
nodes.summary: Interactive hallucination visualizations: a next-token probability bar chart, a temperature/softmax slider demo, and a covariate-shift Plotly plot tying distribution drift to hallucination risk.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level functions render Plotly charts and wire theme-change redraws via window.__MN_DARK.

nodes.name: Inference Optimization
nodes.summary: Lesson on inference optimization: the memory-bandwidth-bound math, quantization (GPTQ/AWQ/SmoothQuant/BitNet/QuIP#), KV-cache management, paged attention, FlashAttention, and speculative decoding.

nodes.name: Production Serving & Inference
nodes.summary: Lesson on production serving: TTFT/TPOT latency targets, the KV-cache memory tax, MQA/GQA, paged attention (vLLM), continuous batching, and the serving stack.

nodes.name: Prompt Engineering: How to talk to LLMs
nodes.summary: Lesson on prompt engineering: defining roles, specificity/entropy, avoiding negations, delimiters, input canonicalization, plus chain-of-thought, few-shot, and latent-space steering.

nodes.name: promptengineering.js
nodes.summary: Seven Plotly visualizations for prompt engineering: specificity-vs-entropy cone, negation space, technique radar, CoT accuracy curve, prompt-injection heatmap, a 3D familiar/interesting/minimal semantic cloud, and an interactive prompt lab.
nodes.languageNotes: Large set of top-level render functions each building a distinct Plotly trace; no IIFE scoping.

nodes.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Giving LLMs a Search Engine
nodes.summary: Lesson on Retrieval-Augmented Generation: the retrieve-then-generate pipeline, chunking, embedding, vector databases, and top-k retrieval to ground answers.

nodes.name: rag.js
nodes.summary: RAG demo: a pipeline diagram, a context-cost comparison table, and an interactive similarity search that embeds a query and documents as bag-of-tag vectors and ranks them by cosine similarity.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE with runtime-injected scoped CSS; search uses tag-count bag-of-words vectors rather than real embeddings.

nodes.name: Reasoning & Test-Time Compute
nodes.summary: Lesson on reasoning and test-time compute: chain-of-thought (zero/few-shot), self-consistency, Tree/Graph of Thoughts, and the o1/R1 paradigm of scaling compute at inference time.

nodes.name: Reliability — Calibration & Knowing When to Stop
nodes.summary: Short lesson on reliability: calibration via temperature scaling, aleatoric vs epistemic uncertainty, abstention/OOD detection, and conformal prediction for finite-sample guarantees.

nodes.name: Running Models Locally
nodes.summary: Lesson on running LLMs locally: consumer/Apple-hardware VRAM table, the GGUF format and llama.cpp quantization schemes, and Ollama/LM Studio setup.

nodes.name: Security & Adversarial Attacks
nodes.summary: Lesson on security and adversarial attacks: direct/indirect prompt injection, jailbreaking, data poisoning and backdoors, plus the corresponding defenses.

nodes.name: Symbolic AI, Knowledge Graphs & Neuro-Symbolic AI
nodes.summary: Lesson on symbolic AI and the neuro-symbolic synthesis: propositional/first-order logic, knowledge representation (RDF/ontologies), and how symbolic methods complement neural nets.

nodes.name: Training Data Curation
nodes.summary: Lesson on training-data curation: the scale and composition of frontier corpora, Common Crawl, quality filtering, deduplication, and decontamination.

nodes.name: Training Infrastructure
nodes.summary: Lesson on distributed training infrastructure: the per-step memory budget, data/tensor/pipeline/sequence parallelism, and the ZeRO/FSDP families.

nodes.name: Semantic Search & Vector Databases: Finding Needles in Haystacks
nodes.summary: Lesson on semantic search and vector databases: BM25, dense-vector cosine similarity, hybrid search, and ANN (HNSW/IVF) for sub-50ms top-k retrieval.

nodes.name: vectorsearch.js
nodes.summary: Semantic-search demo: a pipeline diagram, keyword/semantic/hybrid comparison cards, and an interactive dual search scoring documents with a BM25-like keyword score and tag-based cosine semantic score.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE with runtime-injected scoped CSS; side-by-side keyword vs semantic result columns.

nodes.name: How LLMs Search the Web
nodes.summary: Lesson on how LLMs search the web: the tool-use pipeline (intent detection, search API, fetch, extract, chunk/rank, generation) and when a query actually requires a search.

nodes.name: websearch.js
nodes.summary: Web-search demo: pipeline and fetch diagrams plus an animated step-by-step simulation of intent-detect -> search -> fetch -> extract -> rank -> answer over a mock topic database.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE with runtime-injected scoped CSS; staged setTimeout animation over a mock results DB.

nodes.name: renderWindowDiagram
nodes.summary: Renders the horizontal segmented bar showing how the context window is divided across system prompt, history, RAG docs, current query, and generation space.

nodes.name: renderLostMiddleDiagram
nodes.summary: Renders the U-shaped attention bar chart demonstrating the 'lost in the middle' effect, where models attend most to the start and end of context.

nodes.name: TrainingLab
nodes.summary: Scenario-driven demo object holding raw 'base' vs 'fine-tuned' data for three cases (Wikipedia HTML, C++ sort, 0.999=1 forum) and rendering them side by side with Prism/Mermaid/Markdown.

nodes.name: loadFinetuningModule
nodes.summary: Public module loader that registers the base-output element for lazy init via an IntersectionObserver and returns a resolved promise.

nodes.name: loadHallucinationsModule
nodes.summary: Public module loader that initializes all hallucination visualizations and returns a resolved promise.

nodes.name: renderTokenPrediction
nodes.summary: Renders a static bar chart of next-token probabilities after 'The sky is...' to illustrate next-token prediction.

nodes.name: renderTemperatureDemo
nodes.summary: Renders an interactive temperature slider that recomputes a softmax over token logits and explains how higher temperature increases hallucination likelihood.

nodes.name: renderCovariateShift
nodes.summary: Renders an interactive Plotly plot showing the shift between training and real-world distributions and the resulting hallucination-risk meter.

nodes.name: loadPromptengineeringModule
nodes.summary: Public module loader that renders all prompt-engineering visualizations and wires a window resize handler, returning a resolved promise.

nodes.name: renderPESpecificityCone
nodes.summary: Renders a horizontal entropy bar chart showing how prompt specificity reduces output uncertainty.

nodes.name: renderPENegationSpace
nodes.summary: Renders a 2-D embedding scatter showing why negations ('not happy') barely move a vector versus the true opposite.

nodes.name: renderPETechRadar
nodes.summary: Renders a radar chart comparing prompt-engineering techniques across accuracy, creativity, safety, consistency, speed, and robustness.

nodes.name: renderPECoTAccuracy
nodes.summary: Renders a line chart showing chain-of-thought accuracy rising step by step from a direct guess to the final answer.

nodes.name: renderPEPromptInjection
nodes.summary: Renders a heatmap of prompt-injection attack success rates across defense levels.

nodes.name: renderPEContradictionIntersection
nodes.summary: Renders an interactive 3-D cloud of points across familiar/interesting/minimal semantic regions, illustrating overlapping prompt-contradiction spaces.

nodes.name: renderPEInteractiveLab
nodes.summary: Renders an interactive prompt lab (the 17-sheep riddle) that toggles chain-of-thought and animates per-step confidence.

nodes.name: renderPipelineDiagram
nodes.summary: Renders the RAG pipeline as connected boxes: user query -> retriever -> top-k docs -> LLM -> grounded answer.

nodes.name: raglab_embed
nodes.summary: Embeds text as a bag-of-tag frequency vector over the shared document tag vocabulary.

nodes.name: raglab_cosineSim
nodes.summary: Computes the cosine similarity between two vectors.

nodes.name: raglab_runSearch
nodes.summary: Runs the interactive RAG search: embeds the query, scores all docs by cosine similarity, and renders ranked results with retrieved/not-used tags.

nodes.name: renderPipelineDiagram
nodes.summary: Renders the vector-search pipeline: documents -> chunking -> embedding -> vectors -> vector DB (HNSW/IVF) -> ANN search -> top-k results.

nodes.name: renderSearchComparison
nodes.summary: Renders three comparison cards for keyword (BM25), semantic (vector), and hybrid search.

nodes.name: vslab_keywordScore
nodes.summary: Computes a simplified BM25-style keyword relevance score between a query and a document.

nodes.name: vslab_semanticScore
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between a query and a document using tag-based heuristic embeddings.

nodes.name: vslab_runSearch
nodes.summary: Runs the interactive demo, scoring all documents with both keyword and semantic methods and rendering two ranked result columns.

nodes.name: renderPipelineDiagram
nodes.summary: Renders the web-search pipeline: query -> intent detection -> search API -> fetch & extract -> chunk & re-rank -> LLM -> grounded answer.

nodes.name: renderFetchDiagram
nodes.summary: Renders the content-fetch sub-pipeline: raw HTML -> Readability/Trafilatura -> clean text -> chunker -> relevant passages.

nodes.name: wslab_detectTopic
nodes.summary: Maps a free-text query to a mock-topic key (python/transformer/climate/ai) by keyword match, defaulting to a generic topic.

nodes.name: wslab_runSearch
nodes.summary: Simulates the full web-search pipeline with timed, animated steps over a mock result database and renders a grounded final answer with citations.
